items.reason: Vitamin C is a pregnancy-friendly option for a brighter-looking, more even-looking tone, used in the morning.
A tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides is a pregnancy-friendly daily shield that helps keep the look of dark patches from deepening.
Your moisture score reads low and your skin type is dry, so this ceramide moisturizer adds comfort and cushions the skin alongside vitamin C.

response.routine_note: Please check your hydroquinone cream with your doctor or dermatologist while pregnant, as dark patches during pregnancy are better guided by them than by anything we sell, so I have not added any further brightening products. Use vitamin C in the morning, then moisturizer, then SPF, reapplying SPF through the day.
